_comment: A midday in July on this installation: the PV string produces, the house draws, the surplus goes into the battery and a little is fed in. Chosen so that all four values in the flow diagram are non-zero and one of them is negative - the sign is a formatting rule (NumFmt.h) and a mock without one never shows it. Magnitudes are the ones the real device produces; the counters come from a real capture of this panel.
